page.overview:
Who is George New-Win?

George New-Win is character in Cars 3. He is a next-generation racer sponsored by Leak Less. His racing number is 52.

He debuts at the Florida 500 race, he started in the 13th position and spends the majority of the race in 13th. Later, he was hit by Cam Spinner, he received heavy damage and didn't finish the race.
